name: Footprint Evaluation
definition: A forward mapping rendering algorithm for regular volumetric grids with potentially different spacings in the three grid directions, calculating image plane footprints for each data sample.
summary: Footprint Evaluation is a forward-mapping volume rendering algorithm that projects voxels as 2D splats, distinguished by pre-integrating 3D kernels into a 2D footprint table to avoid on-the-fly integration.
